_about: The difficulty slider. Each level multiplies: 'fee' what a golfer pays for a hole, 'mood_bad' how hard a bad moment hits their mood, 'mood_good' how much a good one lifts it, 'weeds' and 'pests' how fast they appear and spread, 'wear' how fast play wears the turf, 'wages' what staff cost, 'swing' how wide the player's swing-timing margins are. 'default' is the level a new game starts on.

levels.name: Relaxed
levels.blurb: Generous golfers, slow weeds. For building in peace.

levels.name: Normal
levels.blurb: The game as it was balanced.

levels.name: Hard
levels.blurb: Golfers pay less and grumble sooner. Weeds do not wait.

levels.name: Brutal
levels.blurb: Tight wallets, short tempers, and a course that wants to be a meadow.
